The '''Bloodfiend''' was a monstrous [[K'lor'slug/Legends|k'lor'slug]] that resided in the [[Sith Academy (Korriban)|Sith Academy]] of [[Korriban/Legends|Korriban]]. When an acolyte took the [[rite of blood and bone]], they had to confront and defeat the Bloodfiend. The initiation rite had been perpetuated at the Academy for [[Time/Legends|millennia]].
